names.name: The Anatomy Of Abandonment, Kostabi Painting

descriptions.text:
A Mark Kostabi oil painting on canvas. Limited edition of 10. Size 250 x 200 cm.

Mark Kostabi was one of the leading figures in the 1980s art movement in New York. He is exhibited in many galleries and museums all over the world and presently has studios in New York as well as in Rome, Italy.
